title: Unique prescribed derived signed-line comparison at one exponent
statement: Fix a finite coefficient setting P [def-pur-conventions], levels $1\le m\le n=P.level$, a scheme T over $\operatorname{Spec}(P.field.k)$, and any normalized family c of ordinary signed semilinear maps as in [def-pur-finite-tensor-reduction-data]. For every fixed integer r there exists a unique isomorphism b from Q(A_T(r)[0]) to B_T(r)[0] whose image under the actual scalar-adjunction hom bijection is the single-complex image of c_r in fixed-scalar coordinates followed by the inverse exact-restriction/single comparison. This states existence at one exponent for an already given ordinary normalized family; it does not assert ordinary existence or a chosen family.

proof.text: Apply the existence witness for the prescribed transpose at the fixed exponent r.

Apply the fully proved generic pointwise_unique API to the actual transpose data. Its proof is precisely the previous HEq transitivity, homEquiv injectivity and Iso.ext argument, formed before concrete specialization.

lean.statement:
theorem existsUnique_finiteTensorLineDerivedComparison (P : PurityFiniteSetting.{u})
    (m : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hmn : m ≤ P.level) (T : Scheme.{u})
    [T.Over (Spec (.of P.field.k))]
    (c : P.FiniteTensorLineMaps m hm hmn T)
    (hc : P.FiniteTensorLineMapsNormalized m hm hmn T c) (r : ℤ) :
    ∃! b : (P.finiteTensorReduction m hm hmn T).obj (P.finiteTensorFixedLine T r) ≅
        (P.finiteReductionSetting m hm).finiteTensorFixedLine T r,
      (P.finiteTensorLineComparisonData m hm hmn T).Pointwise c r b
